purpose: Prove FEATURES.md MOD-015 full-path loading of the GPU runtime pack on Windows and preview AC-017
mechanism: ggml-cuda.dll linked with /DELAYLOAD:cublas64_13.dll (delayimp.lib), so cuBLAS is not loaded at process start

At the start of main, when ALUNAN_GPU_RUNTIME_DIR is set: SetDefaultDllDirectories(LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32), then LoadLibraryExW by full path for cublasLt64_13.dll and cublas64_13.dll with LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DLL_LOAD_DIR | LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32; any failure exits 1 before model loading
The delay-load helper then resolves cublas64_13.dll to the already-loaded module
patch: tools/phase0/patches/yue-synth-gpu-runtime-dir.patch (applied to a copy of the pinned yue2.cpp f17d526; the pinned checkout is unchanged)
build: tools/phase0/build-yue2-cpp-runtime-proto.cmd (sm_89, same toolchain as windows-cpp-build.json); the binary still reports the upstream version string, so it is identified by hash
fakes: 4,096 random bytes named cublas64_13.dll and cublasLt64_13.dll, planted in the engine's own folder, the working directory and a folder prepended to PATH
findings: With ALUNAN_GPU_RUNTIME_DIR set, cuBLAS loaded only from the verified pack, even with the CUDA toolkit on PATH and fakes planted in the app folder, working directory and PATH; the WAV matched the reference hash
Without it, the default search loaded the toolkit's cuBLAS, and with fakes planted it loaded a fake and failed at first cuBLAS use (exception 0xC06D007E) after model loading and planning
A missing or unreadable pack fails in 0.08 s with a clear message before any model loads
The full-path mechanism needs a small engine patch plus a delay-load link flag; Phase 3's worker adapter should own it and pass the verified runtime folder explicitly
limitations: Windows only; Linux needs the equivalent (dlopen of absolute paths before ggml-cuda, or an $ORIGIN-relative RUNPATH to a controlled folder) and has not been tested
The worker's pre-launch hash check of the pack (MOD-015) is not part of this engine-side proof
System32 remains searched for other DLLs; a same-named library there requires administrator rights to place
